<?php
// Registers the active theme's bundled images so the block has something to show.
add_action( 'init', function () {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'HappyPrime\ThemeImageBlock\register_theme_image' ) ) {
		return;
	}
	foreach ( (array) glob( get_template_directory() . '/assets/images/*.{webp,jpg,png}', GLOB_BRACE ) as $file ) {
		$name = pathinfo( $file, PATHINFO_FILENAME );
		\HappyPrime\ThemeImageBlock\register_theme_image(
			$name,
			array(
				'title' => ucwords( str_replace( '-', ' ', $name ) ),
				'alt'   => ucfirst( str_replace( '-', ' ', $name ) ),
				'path'  => 'assets/images/' . basename( $file ),
			)
		);
	}
} );
